items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Interviewee mentions Cab Calloway only in the context of Willie Bryant being compared to him ('young Cab Calloway') and the interviewer mentioning their own time with Calloway; no direct interaction between Teddy Wilson and Cab Calloway is described.

ctx.x: And you were with Willie Bryant, you say. Now, when did you go with Bryant, was that after you came to New York?

After Benny Carter, yeah. I came in to play with Benny Carter and after Benny got out of the band business, he let the big band go, I joined Willie Bryant. And later on, while I was with Willie, Benny Carter came on and Willie saw it as a musical director and put the band in first class shape and played lead alto, too, himself, in the band. Made some arrangements for Willie because Willie was getting to where he was going to be the young Cab Calloway in a way you know. Because in those days you always had…
That's right, he took the _______ s over, didn't he.
